t: You're in the area of the ancient Hundred of Blackheath, an old division of north-west Kent. It became obsolete by the start of the 20th century, as local government was reformed. The name now belongs to a district of south-east London, and the old hundred lies mainly within the Royal Borough of Greenwich. Frederic Lang was born here in 1852. He moved to New Zealand and became a politician, joining the Reform Party in 1909, and served as Speaker of the House of Representatives from 1913 to 1922.
